big_case.notes: Follow-on FAAAA safety-exception petition resolved by a routine unsigned GVR in light of Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II; no cert-stage amici, private parties, state intermediate court below. Some supply-chain relevance (whether shippers/receivers can invoke preemption) but the order settles nothing beyond sending this case back.
